description: The page of a host, streamer, journalist or guest of Argentine streaming on Prim: who they are, what they do, the programmes they are on now (and whether they are on air or when the next show is), their own channel, their social media and their upcoming events, with the canonical url of their page on prim.profblu.com. Accepts the person's name, nickname, slug or Prim url; a bare first name or nickname shared by several people («Nico») returns found=false with the candidates in suggestions, so ask the user which one. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to es. Use the language the user writes in.

person.description: Name, nickname, slug or Prim url, e.g. «Migue Granados», «Nico Occhiato» or https://prim.profblu.com/p/migue

name: get_person

roles.description: What they do: host, streamer, singer, comedian, journalist, columnist, athlete, actor, producer

suggestions.description: Only when what was asked for is not in Prim (or matches several): up to 3 similar names, to ask the user «did you mean…?». Nothing is claimed about them.

date.description: Date in Buenos Aires time, YYYY-MM-DD: the one prim.profblu.com shows

localTime.description: Start time at the venue's own time zone, HH:MM

time.description: Start time in Buenos Aires time, HH:MM: the one prim.profblu.com shows

url.description: Canonical page of the event on prim.profblu.com: cite it
Canonical page of the person on prim.profblu.com: cite it

title: A person in Argentine streaming
